introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Advanced Level Examination. Information & Communication Technologies, Subject code 0796, Paper 3 Group 1. Examination date: June 2023. Duration: two hours.**

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. Do not write in pencil. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answer. Your results must be recorded in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Candidates must allow for themselves enough time to complete and check their work where these are required. The supervisor will guide you on how to save your files but usually you will be expected to save all your work in one folder named *Candidate folder* that will be created in your desktop. When an imperative programming language is required to write program code, either Standard [ISO] Pascal or [ANSI] C programming language may be used. You should ensure all your work is collected and printed before leaving the examination room. All printed work should be inserted in this booklet and well stapled. Carefully handle all equipment put at your disposal to avoid accidents that may lead to a disaster or system failure. Report any case of system or device malfunction to your supervisor.

**Answer ALL TASKS.**

The paper has three tasks: Task 1 (Presentation, 17 marks), Task 2 (Spreadsheet, 25 marks) and Task 3 (Programming, 7 marks).
enonce_intro_markdown:
**TASK 1 (Presentation: 17 Marks)**

The ICT club is invited to make a presentation of the components of a computer to a group of business women. You are a member of a group in this club to make a presentation on output devices of the computer. Your teacher has prepared a presentation having two slides and saved as *PC Output* in your *Candidate folder* found in your desktop. Sample pictures of slide 2 and slide 4 are displayed below. You are expected to complete the presentation following the content and description in Table 1.

In all the slides, use the **Times New Roman** font and consider the first line to be the title of the slide.

![fig-1](gce-al-ict-2023-p3-officiel-cameroun_exercice_1_fig_1.png)

*Slide 1: the content is given in the presentation provided in the candidate folder; do not modify it. The picture above shows slide 2 (left) and slide 4 (right).*

questions.enonce_markdown:
Open the presentation named *PC Output* found in your *candidate folder*. State the name and the version of the presentation software you are using.

Name: ........................  Version: ........................  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Open the *Candidate folder* on the desktop and double-click the file **PC Output**, so that it opens in the presentation program installed on the computer. Then read the name and version of that program (in Microsoft PowerPoint: *File > Account > About PowerPoint*; in LibreOffice Impress: *Help > About LibreOffice*).

A correct answer names the software really used and its version, for example:

- Name: **Microsoft PowerPoint**, Version: **2016** (or 2013, 2019, 365...);
- or Name: **LibreOffice Impress**, Version: **7.x**.

The mark is awarded for a real presentation program (not a word processor or a spreadsheet) and a plausible version number; the exact value depends on the machine of the examination centre. The presentation opens with two slides: slide 1 (given, not to be modified) and slide 2 (to be modified in the next part).

Title: center and bold. Font size of title: 44. Font size of content: 28. Bullets: level 1 and 2. | (4 marks) |

The picture of slide 2 shows: title *OUTPUT DEVICE OF A DESKTOP PC*; bullets *The principal output device of a desktop PC is the monitor.*, *This is used to display information in the computer to the user.*, *There are two types of monitors:* and, one level lower, *Cathode Ray Tube (CRT) monitor.* and *Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) monitor.*

*[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Go to slide 2 in the slide pane and work in this order.

1. **Title.** Click in the title box (the first line, *OUTPUT DEVICE OF A DESKTOP PC*), select the text (Ctrl+A), set the font to **Times New Roman**, size **44**, click **Bold** (Ctrl+B) and **Center** (Ctrl+E).
2. **Content.** Click in the content box, select all the text, set the font to **Times New Roman** and size **28**.
3. **Bullet levels.** Put the cursor in each of the three main lines (*The principal output device...*, *This is used to display...*, *There are two types of monitors:*) and leave them at **level 1**. Put the cursor in the two lines *Cathode Ray Tube (CRT) monitor.* and *Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) monitor.* and press **Tab** (or *Home > Increase List Level*) so that they become **level 2** bullets, indented under the line *There are two types of monitors:*, exactly as in the picture.
4. Check that nothing overflows the slide and that the text and the layout look like the sample picture of slide 2.

Result expected: centred bold title of size 44, content of size 28 in Times New Roman, three level-1 bullets followed by two level-2 bullets.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Slide 3 of Table 1 (Slide Details). | Slide No | Content | Formatting Guidelines | Marks | |---|---|---|---| | Slide 3 | **ADVANTAGES OF CRT OVER LCD**
- Produce brighter and sharper images
- Have a larger viewing angle.
- Less expensive.
- Harder display surface to withstand pressure. | Title and content layout. Title: center and bold. Font size of title: 44. Font size of content: 28. Insert the picture of CRT monitor found in your candidate folder. | (5 marks) | *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. **New slide.** After slide 2, click *Home > New Slide* and choose the layout **Title and Content** (*Home > Layout > Title and Content*).
2. **Title.** Type `ADVANTAGES OF CRT OVER LCD`, select it, set **Times New Roman**, size **44**, **Bold** and **Center**.
3. **Content.** In the content placeholder type the four lines (one bullet each):

   - Produce brighter and sharper images
   - Have a larger viewing angle.
   - Less expensive.
   - Harder display surface to withstand pressure.

   Select them, set **Times New Roman** and size **28**.
4. **Picture.** Click *Insert > Pictures* (or *Image*), browse to the **Candidate folder**, select the picture of the CRT monitor and insert it. Resize it (keeping the proportions with a corner handle) and place it beside the text, so that it does not hide any word and stays inside the slide.
5. Check the spelling of the title and of the four bullets, then look at the whole slide.

Points checked: correct layout (title and content), title text, title centred, bold and size 44, content of size 28 in Times New Roman, the four bullets typed correctly, the CRT picture inserted and well placed.

*[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. **New slide.** After slide 3 insert a new slide with the layout **Title and Content** (the sample shows a title on the first line and four bullets below).
2. **Title.** Type `ADVANTAGES OF LCD OVER CRT`, in **bold**, in **Times New Roman** (the general instruction of the task: all slides in Times New Roman). Place it at the top of the slide as in the sample.
3. **Content.** Type the four bullets exactly:

   - More portable.
   - Produce less heat.
   - Consumes less electricity.
   - Causes less damage to the eyes.

   Any bullet symbol is accepted (*Home > Bullets*: the arrow-type bullets of the sample or another type, as the sentence "You may use other bullet type" allows).
4. **Picture.** *Insert > Pictures*, choose the picture of the **LCD** monitor in the *Candidate folder*, resize it and put it at the upper right of the text, as in the sample, without covering the text.

Points checked: title typed correctly and formatted like the sample, four bullets typed correctly, bullet type, LCD picture inserted at the right place.

1. Insert a new slide after slide 4 and choose the layout **Title Only** (*Home > Layout > Title Only*): the slide has only a title box.
2. In the title box type on two lines `THANK YOU` then, after pressing Enter (or Shift+Enter), `FOR YOUR KIND ATTENTION`.
3. Select the two lines and set the font to **Times New Roman**, size **40**, click **Bold** and **Center**.

Points checked: Title Only layout, text typed correctly on two lines, size 40, bold, centred.

Save the presentation first (Ctrl+S) in the *Candidate folder*. Then click *File > Print*. In the settings choose **Custom Range** (in LibreOffice Impress: *Slides* and `2-4`) and type `2-4`, choose the layout **Full Page Slides**, check the preview (three pages: slide 2, slide 3 and slide 4, but not slides 1 and 5), then click **Print**.
